defensiveAbilities.name: Death Throes
defensiveAbilities.description: When a frost worm dies, it explodes in a 100ft Burst of searing cold blood. All creatures and objects in range take 10d8 Cold Damage damage (Basic DC 29 Reflex Saving Throw save).

defensiveAbilities.name: Human Cunning
defensiveAbilities.description: Pakano's allies are unaffected by his worm chill aura and Worm Trill, and his Freezing Blood affects random enemies instead of random creatures. His Death Throes, however, still affect all creatures and objects in a 100-foot burst.

defensiveAbilities.name: Worm Chill
defensiveAbilities.description: 5 feet. A creature that enters or begins its turn in the emanation takes 3d6 Cold Damage damage (Basic DC 29 Reflex Saving Throw).

defensiveAbilities.name: Worm Trill
defensiveAbilities.description:
The frost worm emits a hypnotic trill. Each non-frost worm creature within 100 feet must attempt a DC 32 Will Saving Throw save. The effects of Worm Trill last for 1 round, but if the frost worm uses this ability again on subsequent rounds, it extends this duration by 1 round for any creature already affected.

Success The creature is unaffected and is immune to Worm Trill for 24 hours.

Failure The creature is Fascinated by the frost worm.

Critical Failure As failure, but the fascinated condition doesn't end if the frost worm uses hostile actions against the creature.

offensiveAbilities.name: Breath Weapon
offensiveAbilities.description:
The frost worm exhales a blast of frost, dealing 13d6 Cold Damage damage to creatures in a 50ft Cone (Basic DC 32 Reflex Saving Throw save).

It can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Freezing Blood
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The frost worm takes piercing or slashing damage

Effect The frost worm's freezing blood sprays out on a random creature within 10 feet of the frost worm. That creature takes 7d6 Cold Damage damage (Basic DC 29 Reflex Saving Throw save).
